torilo_1.m: Welcome to the Foaming Flask tavern. We welcome all travelers in here.
r: Thank you. Are you the innkeeper here?
Have you seen a boy called Rincel around here recently?
Hey, I noticted all of those beer barrels outside and all those drunk guards over there.

torilo_2.m: I am Torilo, the proprietor of this establishment. Please have a seat anywhere you like.
r: Can I see what you have available for food and drink?
Do you have somewhere I can rest?
Are those guards always shouting and yelling that much?

torilo_beer.m: OK, and this is your business why?
r: Well, of course it is not my business, but I am just wondering...
Why you have so much beer for such a small-sized tavern and where you got it? I would like some to bring home to father.

torilo_beer_20.m: Well, for as why I have so much, that is none of your business. As for where I got it, that information will cost you.
r: What? Are you asking me to buy information from you? Why would I want to do that?

torilo_beer_30.m: Well, for the same reason why my bed is so expensive to rent...It's valuable.
r: Funny, I thought it was because you are a jerk.
Oh, fine! What do you want? Gold? How much?

torilo_beer_40.m: Hmm...let me think...how does {10000} gold sound?
r: That sounds fair. Take it. Now the information please!
That sounds ridiculous! I won't pay that.
That sounds ridiculous too, but I've had enough negotiating with you. [You reach into your bag, grab the coins and slam them on the ground] Take it. Now the information please!
That sounds ridiculous! I won't pay that

torilo_beer_bribe6000_10.m: That's fine with me, but no information for you.

r: That sounds fair. Take it. Now the information please!
That still sounds ridiculous and I won't pay it.

torilo_beer_jerk.m: Well, it's because of little snot-nosed kids like you

torilo_beer_pay.m: Oh, I love the sound of clanking coins. Anyways...myself and other tavern owners have a 'business agreement' with a group of 'distributors'.

torilo_beer_pay_10.m: It means that that is all I will tell you and I suggest you talk to another tavern owner.

torilo_default.m: Was there anything else you wanted?
r: Can I see what you have available for food and drink?
Are those guards always shouting and yelling that much?
Have you seen a boy called Rincel around here recently?

torilo_guards_1.m: *Sigh* Yes. Those guards have been here for quite some time now.

torilo_guards_2.m: They seem to be looking for something or someone, but I am not sure who or what.

torilo_guards_3.m: I hope the Shadow watches over us so that nothing bad happens to the Foaming Flask tavern because of them.

torilo_rest_1.m: Yes, you already rented the back room.

torilo_rest_2.m: Please feel free to use it in any way you like. I hope you can get some sleep even with these guards yelling their songs.

torilo_rest_3.m: Oh yes. We have a very comfortable back room here in the Foaming Flask tavern.

torilo_rest_4.m: Available for only 250 gold. Then you can use it as much as you like.
r: 250 gold? Sure, that's nothing to me. Here you go.
250 gold is a lot, but I guess it is worth it. Here you go.
That sounds a bit too much for me.

torilo_rest_6.m: Thank you. The room is now rented to you.

torilo_rincel_1.m: Rincel? No, not that I can recall. Actually, we don't get many children in here. *chuckle*

torilo_shop_1.m: Absolutely. We have a wide selection of food and beverages.

beer_bootlegging.10: I've agreed to help the Feygard patrol captain investigate why there is so much beer on the Foaming flask tavern property.
beer_bootlegging.20: After bribing Torilo, the owner of the Foaming flask, he stated that he and other tavern owners had a 'business agreement' with a group of 'distributors'. He suggested that I ask other tavern owners for more information.
beer_bootlegging.30: After bribing Tharwyn, the owner of the Vilegard tavern, he stated as part of his 'business agreement', Dunla, the local thief, is one of his 'distributors'. He suggested that I talk to him.
beer_bootlegging.40: Dunla, the thief in Vilegard instructed me to speak with Farrick if I want to learn more about the tavern owner's 'business agreement' with their 'distributors'.
beer_bootlegging.50: Farrik told me that the beer is coming from Sullengard. I really should go there next.
beer_bootlegging.60: To earn his trust, Mayor Ale has asked that I deliver his letter to Kealwea, the Sullengard priest.
beer_bootlegging.70: I have done what Mayor Ale has asked of me as I have delivered his letter. I should now return to him.
beer_bootlegging.80: Mayor Ale has explained everything to me about the 'business agreement' with the Thieves guild. I should head back to the Foaming flask tavern and speak with the captain.
beer_bootlegging.90: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern all about the beer bootlegging operation.
beer_bootlegging.100: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that the beer was being distributed by the Thieves guild.
beer_bootlegging.110: I informed the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern that Sullengard was responsible for brewing the beer.
beer_bootlegging.120: I lied to the guard captain at the Foaming flask tavern and told him nothing about the beer bootlegging operation.

wrye.40: Wrye wants me to go search for clues as to what has happened to her son.

wrye.42: I heard of a boy being in the Foaming Flask tavern a while ago. Apparently he left to the west of the tavern somewhere.
